The 1971 war added the Chhamb sector to AJK; the pre-war outer line is not the NE line.

Outside scope. Before 1970 West Pakistan was one province (Karachi federal area until 1961, Gwadar from 1958, Rann of Kutch award 1968 changed Sindh); not built here. Examined 2026-10-06 with geoBoundaries districts: (1) the Frontier Regions (tribal areas outside NWFP province 1947–1955) are merged into the polygons of the settled districts Peshawar, Kohat, Bannu, Lakki Marwat, Tank and Dera Ismail Khan, so NWFP and the tribal areas of 1947–1955 cannot be separated; (2) the Rann of Kutch award (1968, implemented 1969) moved the line inside today’s Badin and Tharparkar districts, so Sindh (1947–1955) and West Pakistan (1955–1969) cannot be drawn with today’s districts; (3) the Kashmir ceasefire line of 1949 differs from today’s line of control inside the AJK/Gilgit-Baltistan atoms.
